subject: DIC value change when re-run same model

messages.author: 87db6da4a9a8d291
messages.subject: DIC value change when re-run same model
parts:
Hi INLA experts,

I was trying to run a spatial varying coefficient model, but every time I re-ran the model, the dic value and specifically, the hyperparamter for the iid change. Could anyone please help me? Thanks in advance. Here is my code.


prec.prior1 <- list(prec = list(prior = "loggamma", param = c(1, 0.5)))



f1<- premature.z~ICEwbinc+hb_mean+cc_mean+phy_mean+
  f(ID2, model = "besag",graph = gus, hyper=prec.prior1, scale.model = TRUE)+
  f(ID1, model="iid",hyper=prec.prior1)+
  f(ID3, ICEwbinc, model="besag",graph = gus,hyper = prec.prior1 )



result1<- inla(f1, data=outcome.ice.factor,
               family = "gaussian",
               control.compute =list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE))


Best,
Alex
